title: Contacting the National Consumer Helpline
kind: Original factual summary of official guidance
text: For a consumer complaint about an online purchase, return or delayed refund in India, the National Consumer Helpline offers a web portal and the telephone number 1915. Its homepage also links to WhatsApp, the NCH app and UMANG. These are complaint contact channels, not promises that a refund is due. Check the official page for current contact details.

title: Registering and tracking a consumer grievance
kind: Original factual summary of official guidance
text: A consumer can register a grievance through the National Consumer Helpline. Online submission involves registering an account, describing the complaint and attaching available supporting documents. A docket number identifies the grievance. NCH forwards the matter to the relevant organisation and offers status tracking. The app cannot file or track a complaint on your behalf.

title: What the helpline can and cannot promise
kind: Original factual summary of official guidance
text: The National Consumer Helpline provides a pre-litigation route for consumer grievances, including purchase and refund disputes. Registering a complaint does not guarantee a remedy or refund. A consumer who remains dissatisfied may approach the appropriate Consumer Commission. This general guidance does not establish a retailer's return window, warranty coverage, refund processing deadline or an individual consumer's eligibility.
